proposed_state_split.raw_retire_consume: Consume an actually completed engine response and maintain mq_r/mq_n/sl_inf; preserve existing abort release/exception drain. Never simply AND health into step_done.
proposed_state_split.speculative_working: Existing sl_pos/sl_tok/sl_ngen drive next static token while healthy; all effects owned by the current retained context
proposed_state_split.architectural_mirror: Add3*NW+2 bits/user for committed position, token, generated count and user state; CSR/public completion state reads mirror
proposed_state_split.generated_commit: At actual success word0 VALID offer only, snapshot then update mirror from immutable event head; bad/!armed converts a not-yet-offered word0 to ST_FAULT and poisons context
proposed_state_split.prompt_commit_candidate: No CQ exists for non-generated prompt steps. Add fixed per-step internal commit at the actual full source-health horizon, independent of DMA; current output token remains speculative before this edge. Exact horizon/snapshot and compiler receipt prerequisite, not guessed/adopted.
proposed_state_split.failure: Poison invalidates speculative state/cache ownership; retain committed mirror. Do not roll back already-offered success transactions.
proposed_state_split.future_admission: Block I_IDLE pick, I_GO start, D_ERR descriptor admission, final D_PR_W->SL_RUN and endpoint accept/issue whenever bad or !armed; preserve error transactions and drain already launched DMA
proposed_state_split.event_capacity: 16existing events remain finite; add per-user failure_pending bitmap and report-once state. Reuse a mutable queued record as ST_FAULT where possible; otherwise stage at mostNSLOT failure reports until queue space. No engine credit or healthy-case conditional wait added.
proposed_state_split.context_reuse: Only after native KV/VM/collective/host and abort-drained ownership checks plus required fault CQ completion; no SL_FREE solely on observer/pop
proposed_state_split.after_success_offer: Freeze AW/W VALID/address/data until ready; drain word0/B and any committed MSI. A later fault poisons subsequent work and admission, never edits offered payload.
proposed_state_split.PLL_warm: Committed/poison/failure-pending lifetime must be rawPOR or explicit drained context recovery. Existing host_rst_n reset is insufficient; preserving these bits requires preserving/matching CQ pointers, owner/tag/generation and DMA lifecycle too.

analytical_user_state_FF.formula: (3*NW+2 + poison1 + failure_pending1 + report_once1)*NSLOT =59*NSLOT, before retained owner/tag/DMA/reset/copy cost

healthy_schedule_cost.queue_pressure: Public retirement follows CQword0; speculative engine progress remains under finite existing queue/outstanding admission. Full production CQ bandwidth and queue occupancy still must be measured.
healthy_schedule_cost.rejected_model: Hold each next token until host DMA acceptance: unbounded external AW/W/B latency, no finite SU token cost

cache_poison_distribution.actual_ABI_gap: Selected CTL/ATTN/PC have no health_bad/armed input; cf_root__fault/ufh are existing causes, not certified new poison distribution paths
cache_poison_distribution.distribution: registered2-bit root ->4regional trees ->8groups/region ->4PC/group; fanout<=8 at these hierarchy splits, actual face/geometry transport additional
cache_poison_distribution.local_actions: At landed poison inhibit NEW cache read/write commands, request decode/launch, generated-success return and context reuse. Already offered HBM/link writes retain stable protocol and drain into invalid poisoned context; no further cache use after local cut.
cache_poison_distribution.return_distribution_endpoint_FF_floor: (32groups+128PC)*[2registered input bits+1retained poison+2reset landing] =800FF, excludes regional relays, memory-command copies, arming and asynchronous loss capture
cache_poison_distribution.release_rule: No valid/owner reassertion until all launched commands/returns drain and explicit context reinitialization under qualified epoch; no cache data erased or reused merely by clearing health
